interfaces.integration: Separate pipe_recipe_incidence summary and cached-source annotation only. Retain every full Pipe settings failure and leave Path direction/partial limits unresolved.

grammar.common_prefix: int32 direct-edge name index (-1 or observed0), int32 secondary -1, uint32 face_count2, two pairs (int32 name-table index,int32 -1). Exact framed native names match complete generic-tag term groups.
grammar.line116: After28-byte prefix: uint32 endpoint_count2; two40-byte vertex operands, each int32 directvertex -1,uint32 face_count3, three name-index/-1 pairs,two stored zero int32; final stored zero int32. Face triples uniquely select ordered endpoint vertices through reciprocal topology.
grammar.circle120: Common28-byte prefix plus exactly92 retained bytes beginning int32 1. Direct-edge name may match detached and owning edges. Two explicit face operands disambiguate by reciprocal incidence; remaining circular qualifiers are not interpreted.
grammar.association: Unique exact named-face matches, validated BODY/lump/shell/face/loop/coedge rings and edge references, exactly one edge incident to the two named faces. Source BODY membership checked only after incidence uniqueness. No coordinates, ordinal matching or name-duplicate filtering by source-body membership.
grammar.closure: Cached source topology only: distinct endpoint identities on positive-domain straight curve means open; identical endpoint identity on ratio-one ellipse with full2pi edge domain means closed. Pipe direction and partial-limit semantics remain separate.

limitations: The circular92-byte operation tail is retained exactly and not evaluated. No complete native recipe operation, universal naming engine, persistent topology identity or regeneration is claimed.

Only the observed root-component identity-transform initial geometry and116/120-byte edge operand layouts are admitted. Reversed edges, arcs, transforms, other term counts and unresolved BODY topology are rejected.
Raw ASM coordinates are preserved. Saved cm getters independently corroborate these fixtures; no general ASM header-unit or occurrence conversion is inferred.
Source edge parameter domain differs from normalized natural Line/Circle evaluators and Pipe distanceOne/distanceTwo fractions. Actual Path opposition and final partial Path shape are not decoded.
The older brep_edge_circular filename refers to Pipe section shape; the actual source getter and decoded source are an open Line.
